summary: First full run of HT Salgados (backend + frontend). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass covering the product and combo cost breakdown (unit_cost_total, contribution, margins, suggested price, the 'inviável' case), combo cost from component costs plus combo-level extras, sales with products and combos (each sale counted once, component stock goes down, cost_total uses unit_cost_total, low stock blocked), cancelling a sale (status cancelada, revenue removed, 'estorno' movements), stock entrada (weighted average cost plus optional Mercadorias expense), ajuste via counted, perda/vencido deducted at cost, op_expenses excluding Mercadorias, distribution rules (blocked when op_result<=0, informativo items not deducted), expense edit history and cancel, movement edit/cancel, rejecting a reserve withdrawal larger than the balance, cash formula, settings, reports/finance/dashboard, backup export, snapshots, and the restore/reset guards. Frontend: all 10 pages load with no JS errors. Product and combo dialogs compute correctly (live values match the backend), and 'Usar preço sugerido' works. Cart sale (plus, minus, remove, finish), quick sale, the low-stock toast and cancelling from the sales history all work and stock syncs. In ADM, the KPIs and waterfall are correct, percentage edits preview live, Descartar works, the blocked alert shows for an empty period, and reserve deposit and withdraw (rejected over the balance) work. Relatórios CSV and PDF download, the backup JSON download works, reset needs 'APAGAR', snapshots can be created, and the Estoque entrada/ajuste and Despesas create/edit/history/cancel flows work. Mobile 390px: bottom nav and drawer work, but ADM and Relatórios overflow horizontally.

minor.issue: The reserve (and investment) balance can go negative. validate_movement only checks withdrawals, so lowering or cancelling an earlier reserva_deposito after a withdrawal is accepted. Reproduced: deposit 10, withdraw 10, cancel the deposit, reserve = -10. Same for investimento vs resgate_investimento.
A negative 'counted' (e.g. -5) is accepted and sets stock negative even when allow_negative_stock=false. Add counted >= 0 validation.
'date' is a free string. 'not-a-date' is accepted (200) and breaks period filters and the daily series. Validate YYYY-MM-DD.
Not atomic: update_one has no {status:'ativa'} filter, so two concurrent cancels could restore stock twice. Same race for the stock check in create_sale.
The GET has a side effect (auto_snapshot writes the whole DB into one snapshot document). As data grows this will hit MongoDB's 16MB document limit and slow down the first dashboard load of each day.

ui_bugs.issue: The input is controlled as a number (onChange -> toNum), so typing a decimal is impossible: typing '12.5' key by key gives 125 because the trailing '.' is dropped. Values over 100 are also accepted in the preview (the backend then rejects them with 422 when saving). Keep a string draft state like CostComposer does and clamp to 0-100.

issues: Horizontal overflow: scrollWidth 587px, caused by [data-testid='adm-waterfall'] (grid child without min-w-0). The period filter's end date input also wraps and the start input gets cut off.

design_issues.screen: Global period filter / expense / movement dialogs
issues: They use the browser's native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker. It shows in US format (11/01/2026) on desktop Chrome even though the app is pt-BR.

The cart panel and Finalizar button sit below the whole tile grid. On a phone you have to scroll past every product to finish a sale. Consider a sticky cart summary or finish bar above the bottom nav.

action_items: Validate reserve/investment balances when editing or cancelling deposits (block if the resulting balance < 0)
Add counted >= 0 (and respect allow_negative_stock) for stock ajuste
Validate the date format (YYYY-MM-DD) in ExpenseIn and MovementIn
Fix the ADM distribution % inputs to allow decimals (string state) and clamp to 0-100
Fix the mobile horizontal overflow on ADM (adm-waterfall) and Relatórios (report-by-category), e.g. add min-w-0 to the grid children
Consider shadcn Calendar instead of native date inputs, a sticky cart on mobile, and making cancel_sale atomic with an update filter on status
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 906 lines; split it into routers (products/combos, sales/stock, finance/adm, backup).
Snapshots embed the full DB in a single document (16MB limit risk). Store backups as separate per-collection docs or files.
There is no way to cancel or revert a perda/vencido/ajuste stock movement, so a mistaken loss permanently affects op_result.
Seed only runs when settings is missing; after /backup/reset, settings is recreated immediately, so products are never re-seeded (probably intended, but worth noting).
create_sale and cancel_sale aren't atomic (stock check, then insert, then increment). A low risk for a single shop, but use conditional updates.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 core tests); 3 edge validation gaps found
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; 1 input bug, 2 mobile overflow pages)

seed_data_creation: None. Seed untouched (stock value 692.40 verified). TEST_ products and combos created and then soft-deleted, and TEST_ sales, expenses and movements cancelled (they stay in the history as cancelled records). One vencido movement on TEST_Loss (R$ 1.00) can't be reverted through the API, so the current month shows op_result -1.00. Per the test-data rules I did NOT drop collections. If the main agent wants a clean DB, it can drop the collections and restart the backend itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_ht_salgados.py (the xdist config in pytest.ini is fine). The tests use deltas on /api/adm for today, so they work with existing data. probe_edges.py reproduces the reserve-negative, negative-ajuste and bad-date bugs. cleanup_ui_test_data.py cancels the TEST_ records created through the UI.
